summary: Are you worried about a sagging and loose abdomen? TANGLE Sagging Abdominoplasty restores elasticity to your abdomen, solving sagging belly fat and stretch marks at once to complete an elastic and slim abdomen that suits your overall body shape.

prologue.description: If the degree of sagging belly fat is minor and skin elasticity is maintained, some effect can be achieved with liposuction. However, if there is little fat but skin elasticity is poor and sagging, attempting liposuction will cause the skin to sag further and result in very poor cosmetic outcomes, thus abdominoplasty is performed. Abdominoplasty involves a complex process of liposuction + tightening of relaxed abdominal muscles, fixing the navel, and excising sagging skin simultaneously.

crisalix_3d_analysis.title: Tangle Plastic Surgery Crisalix 3D Virtual Plastic Surgery
crisalix_3d_analysis.description: Through the Crisalix 3D virtual plastic surgery program, you can predict the results before and after surgery, reducing the probability of surgical failure and increasing surgical satisfaction. With detailed examinations and thorough consultations with a surgical specialist, and Crisalix 3D virtual plastic surgery, you can preview your appearance after surgery, enabling precise result prediction, greatly increasing satisfaction, and ensuring safe surgery. Crisalix supports perfect consultation down to vividness and minute details through Augmented Reality (AR) technology. For simulation, first take photos, then with thorough consultation and detailed examination with the medical staff, you can check your appearance after surgery with Crisalix.

how_tangle_abdominoplasty.introduction: Tangle Plastic Surgery proposes the most suitable surgical method considering individual body shape, degree of skin sagging, amount of fat, presence of stretch marks, and degree of abdominal muscle relaxation.

methods.name: Mini Abdominoplasty
conditions: When skin sagging below the navel is minor
When abdominal muscle relaxation is minor
When stretch marks are only below the navel
methods.surgical_method: Skin excision below the navel and abdominal muscle strengthening

methods.name: Full Abdominoplasty
conditions: When skin sagging above and below the navel is severe
When abdominal muscle relaxation is severe
When stretch marks are both above and below the navel
methods.surgical_method: Skin excision above and below the navel and abdominal muscle strengthening

methods.name: Extended Abdominoplasty
conditions: When sagging extends not only to the abdomen but also to the flanks and waist
methods.surgical_method: Excision of skin from abdomen, flanks, waist, and abdominal muscle strengthening

methods.name: Reverse Abdominoplasty
conditions: When upper abdomen sagging is severe
methods.surgical_method: Excision of upper abdominal skin and abdominal muscle strengthening

after_care.title: Post-surgery management program as important as the surgery
after_care.description: Tangle Plastic Surgery provides customized post-surgery management such as high-frequency treatment, Smartlux, etc., to reduce swelling and improve skin for a quick return to daily life after surgery.

programs.name: Smartlux
programs.description: Effective for skin regeneration, wound healing, swelling reduction, etc., in recovery with special medical LED.

programs.name: Scar Laser
programs.description: Precise energy is irradiated to the skin, inducing collagen regeneration in the dermis and having a skin regeneration effect.

programs.name: High-frequency Management
programs.description: Not only improves swelling and inflammation but also breaks down remaining fat to shape the body line.

programs.name: Weight Management 1:1 Prescription
programs.description: We manage weight through medication prescription as needed.
